Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- The blanket non-mill refusal became a capability matrix (`verified_for_machine` in `crates/app/src/setup_align.rs`). Each entry names a machine kind and its op kinds. No silent pass: every unlisted pair still refuses and the refusal names the machine kind.
- The refusal law holds where the PR says it holds. I re-ran the guards at the trial-merge tree: waterjet refusal passes, probe/5-axis/tilt stay refused on MillTurn, and an EDM machine-level refusal names the EDM kind.
- Two real bugs fixed on the way: the 4-axis ruled wire pick and the cavity electrode derivation now go through `setup_align::pose_in`. Before, they read document-frame geometry while the setup was aligned. That is a wrong-coordinate path made exact.
- The equivalence suites (`setup_align_lathe`, `setup_align_mill_turn`, `setup_align_non_mill`) compare aligned output against baked twins. I re-ran two of them green: lathe facing/drill match and sinker electrode match.
- `docs/decisions/2287-aligned-non-mill-machines.md` records the matrix and why. `ElectrodeFromFaces::new_in` keeps the MCP tool backward compatible: an explicit setup name forwards, the old call keeps its behaviour.
- Body complete: `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #2287`, conventional subject, no golden moved, "Not exercised" honest.

## Results, merged with main

Trial merge with `origin/main` (`abe24ff09`) had no conflicts; the merge commit was local, never pushed. Built locally in a review worktree on Windows; the refusal and equivalence pins above were re-run by the maintainer lane in that tree.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `setup_align` (10 tests) | pass, 0 failed |
| `setup_align_lathe` / `setup_align_mill_turn` / `setup_align_non_mill` | pass, 0 failed |
| `sinker_electrode_mcp` | pass, 0 failed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean, exit 0 |

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. The matrix is a code list, not a data file. When a new machine kind lands, a compile-time test should fail it into the matrix. `setup_align_non_mill` covers that for the listed kinds; a not-yet-listed kind refuses at the gate by default. Correct today.
2. The PR branched from `upstream/main` at the v0.20.0 fork sync; the trial merge with current `origin/main` was clean.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
